_comment: Every fact here is checked against the page's visible text. Sources: their own site https://teriyakiwoksushiwa.com/ (name, address, phone, hours Sun/Tue-Sat, the four photos), their ordering page https://teriyakiwoksushi.menu11.com/bonneylake/order (all 201 item names + prices, verbatim), and https://www.restaurantji.com/wa/bonney-lake/teriyaki-wok-/ (Monday closed, the three dated review quotes). The 4.4 / 646 Google figure comes from the hunt sheet in Clients/Teriyaki Wok & Sushi.md.
name: Teriyaki Wok & Sushi
address: 9925 214th Ave E, Unit L, Bonney Lake, WA 98391

HOURS CONFLICT 9/7: Hayden found them CLOSED Sun 9/6 ~5:35 PM; their own site + door sign both say Sun 12–8:30. Likely a Labor Day-weekend closure — confirm Sunday hours with the owner before the pitch.

OWNER: several 2025-26 Google reviews say the place changed hands and was remodelled ('they are the new owners', 'what a transformation'); one review names an owner as James. NOT verified — confirm the owner's name before the pitch.
Sushi was added to the teriyaki menu roughly two years ago per reviews — confirm the date before putting it in copy.
_hero: 9/8: hero is the APPROVED daylight-still storefront (locked). Interior photos moved into #about; the lit menu boards open #menu.
